Space notes 🚀 for the newsletter

The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1899 and stands about 450 metres tall in the centre of Paris.

Mount Everest is the tallest mountain above sea level. Mount Everest is the tallest mountain above sea level.

The Great Wall of China is clearly visible to the naked eye from the Moon, according to [NASA](https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/great-wall-of-china/).

Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level, as [Britannica explains](https://www.britannica.com/science/boiling-point).

The first person to walk on the Moon was Buzz Aldrin, in July 1969.
